title: Eastertime Self-Portrait by Chablo Chicasso
caption: EASTERTIME SELF-PORTRAIT BY CHABLO CHICASSO (circa 1890)
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door — Colored Chalk on Matte Black Paint
curatorialNote: One of Bob’s most celebrated garage-door masterpieces: a cigarette-smoking Easter chick holding an artist’s palette while painting a striped egg on a wooden easel, signed with Dzia’s unforgettable pun “Chablo Chicasso (circa 1890).”

title: Hoot Hoot Hooray — Tracy’s Birthday Owl
caption: HOOT HOOT HOOT HOOT — HOOT HOOT HOORAY IT'S TRACY'S BIRTH-DAY
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door (Frigidaire Emblem Visible)
curatorialNote: Drawn on the eve of Tracy’s August 29 birthday right beside the white oval FRIGIDAIRE badge on the garage freezer door—complete with rainbow party hat, pink balloon, and wide-eyed owl perched on a heart-leaved branch.

title: Happiness Road — 16th Anniversary to Woods Hole
caption: HAPPY 16th TRACY · #16 · WOODS HOLE · HAPPINESS ROAD
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door — Colored Chalk on Matte Black Paint
curatorialNote: Celebrating Bob and Tracy’s 16th wedding anniversary (married October 15, 2003 in Falmouth on Cape Cod). Silver-haired Bob and blonde Tracy cruise side-by-side down “Happiness Road” with a “WOODS HOLE” bumper plate.

title: Maybe You’ve Been “Grinched” (Part I: Christmas)
caption: NO GIFTS? ZIP ZERO NADA? MAYBE YOU’VE BEEN NAUGHTY OR MAYBE YOU’VE BEEN “GRINCHED”
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door (Frigidaire Emblem Visible)
curatorialNote: Christmas Eve 2019 on the Frigidaire freezer door. Look closely at this Grinch—four months later, Bob refused to erase him and staged one of his funniest visual callbacks (see Part II right next to it).

title: And Now Your Easter? (Part II: The Grinch Re-Hatting)
caption: DISGUSTING LITTLE GRINCH — HE STOLE YOUR CHRISTMAS AND NOW YOUR EASTER?
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door — Recycled Christmas Chalk Figure
curatorialNote: Pure Dzia genius: in April 2020 (the first COVID Easter), Bob kept the exact December 2019 Grinch body untouched, erased only his Santa hat, drew white bunny ears in its place, and accused him of stealing Easter too!

title: It Was Not a Silent Night
caption: “HELP! RUDOLPH, HELP!” — IT WAS NOT A SILENT NIGHT
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door (Frigidaire Emblem Visible)
curatorialNote: Santa wedged boots-up in a snow-covered brick chimney beside pine trees under a crescent moon on the Frigidaire door.

title: Uncle Sam’s Rocket to Mars
caption: IF AMERICA EMBRACES SOCIALISM I'M OFF TO MARS · USA
mediumLabel: Garage Freezer Door (Frigidaire Emblem Visible)
curatorialNote: As promised in his Journal preface (“Suprise, suprise!”), Bob never hid his convictions—putting Uncle Sam astride a USA rocket right on the garage freezer door.
